title: Supergirl Content Feels Overwhelming and Out of Place
body:
As a paid Finch user, I’m disappointed by the new Supergirl content.

What made Finch special was its gentle, low-effort support on difficult days. Many users struggle with ADHD, burnout, anxiety, chronic fatigue, depression, or simply getting through daily life — sometimes even getting out of bed or drinking water is hard.

The new Supergirl adventures feel too long, require too many clicks, and include too much text. Instead of feeling supportive, they can feel overwhelming and cognitively demanding.

I also do not enjoy the visual style. The graphics feel less warm, cozy, and calming than the atmosphere that originally made Finch feel comforting and safe.

I am sharing this because I care about Finch and want it to succeed. But if the app continues moving in this direction, I may stop using it despite loving what Finch used to be.

Please consider returning to simpler, gentler experiences with less cognitive load for users who are struggling.

author: miiainen

title: Finally an app that works!
body:
A person with multiple mental health issues (and a neurological thingy) here. This app is amazing! AND FREE! 

As a person with ADHD, Finch gives me dopamine for doing tasks I really don’t want to do. As someone with depression it makes me feel like my best is enough, even when my best is just basic things. I mean: It rewards me for brushing my teeth!! This app has truly made me feel more okay with myself, and it has made me care about and have a bond with a digital birdy 😂❤️

Like many of us, I kept getting ads for random selfcare apps on random platforms. And like many of us I kept downloading many of them, only to find out it cost a ton of money, or was so boring I would use it for a week and then forget it existed. Not once in my life I actually felt like an app helped me, or if it did, it helped me for a couple of days. 
Now I’ve been using Finch for almost a year. Sure, I’ve had days when I forgot to log in, but all in all, I use it every👏🏼 single👏🏼 day👏🏼!  

If you’re in doubt, just try it. It’s free, unlike most of the apps advertised to us these days. If it doesn’t work for you, that’s okay, cause you didn’t pay a ton of money to try to help yourself feel better. So it’s worth a shot! ☺️

title: Love it!
body:
I have tried well over 50 different self care/goal/habit/planner related apps and I’m SO impressed! I am not one to stick with habits and life changes but Finch seems to be positively perfect for me! 💖

As a chaotic, easily bored person that still craves the benefits of good habits I have enjoyed:
- The mix of cultivating inner motivation with a sense of outer accountability when needed
- Cute and positive twist to something that can so easily feel like a drag
- An excellent prompt system with a wide selection of journaling, quizzes, breathing exercises etc to help sink in the change
- The app’s ability to double as a daily planner and journal, as it is easy to add once-off tasks to your goals of the day and all the journaling exercises are collected into your daily journal (with insights! 🌟)

As a bonus, I LOVE the focus on extending kindness into your wider communities with the tree town, super vibes and acts of kindness sections! 🥰🌎

I am so happy I found your app. ♥️ Thank you!
